name: PLX-CRSS12
category: Hybrid direct-drive turntable with DVS control
notes: "Cross 12" = PLX-CRSS12. It is USB class compliant (USB-C) and needs no driver. Only the performance pads and their mode buttons send MIDI. The platter is not MIDI or HID: in Digital Vinyl mode the deck generates a control tone on its RCA outputs. Pioneer has published no MIDI table, so these tests learn each message live.

serviceManual.notes: Not public. Pioneer DJ / AlphaTheta supply RRV-numbered service manuals to authorized service centers. No RRV number found for this model.

setup: Connect USB-C to the computer and mains power. Close rekordbox/Serato.
Set the mode switch to Digital Vinyl to check the DVS signal, and to Analog to check the tonearm.
failureModes: Speed or pitch inaccuracy (including the ±50% range)
Pitch fader dead zone at centre, or scratchy fader
MAGVEL clamp grip and torque/weight knob
Dirty or unstable timecode on the RCA outputs
Pads dead, or pad LEDs not lighting
Tonearm bearing play, anti-skate, cartridge/RCA hum

tests.name: MIDI port appears
steps: Press Enable MIDI. Confirm a PLX-CRSS12 port is listed and write its exact name in the notes.

tests.name: Any MIDI arrives
steps: Press any performance pad.

tests.name: Pads 1–4 press/release
steps: Press and release each of the 4 pads, one at a time, several times.
Each needs press and release with no double-triggers.

tests.name: Pads in bank 5–8
steps: Switch the pad bank to 5–8 with the bank button, then press each pad again.
It should send different messages from bank 1–4.

tests.name: Pad mode / bank / shift buttons
steps: Press each pad-mode, bank and shift-type button once. Raise the count in your notes if there are more.

tests.name: Pad LED feedback (echo)
steps: Select the Device MIDI out and press Send. Note whether the pad LEDs light. If not, feedback is probably host-protocol only: record it as a finding.

tests.name: Speed accuracy 33/45 and stop/start
steps: Use a strobe or strobe app at 33 and 45 with pitch at 0. It must be stable.
Try all 3 stop-speed settings and MOTOR OFF.

tests.name: Pitch fader and ranges ±8/±16/±50
steps: Sweep the fader at each tempo range. The OLED value must change smoothly with no jumps.
Centre should read 0.0. Press TEMPO RESET and confirm it returns to 0.

tests.name: MAGVEL clamp & torque knob
steps: In Digital Vinyl mode, fit the clamp. The record should be held firmly.
Turn the weight/torque knob through its range: the feel must change.

tests.name: OLED
steps: Check for dead pixels and that tempo range and key are shown. With software connected, BPM and deck should show.

tests.name: Digital Vinyl control signal
steps: Connect the RCA out to an audio interface input. Choose that input and start the meter.
Digital Vinyl mode, play: both channels should show a strong, steady level. Compare L and R peaks.
Spin backwards and scratch: the level should stay stable. Use the Serato/rekordbox scope for the final timecode check.

tests.name: Analog tonearm path
steps: Analog mode with a record and cartridge: play and check both channels.
Lift the needle and note the noise floor (hum).
